svg.title: Which copy will the coding helper change?
svg.desc: A puzzle needs new Previous and Next buttons. First locate the copy of the puzzle that should receive the edit. Local work. Open the practice puzzle folder on this device and check its latest saved file. Cloud work. Open the connected project and branch. Check whether it contains that same saved version. Check the edit. Mark a word, go to the next puzzle, then come back. The original mark should still be there.
